description: This line plot illustrates how the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage changes with varying values of N, ranging from 0 to 20 along the linear x-axis labeled 'N'. The y-axis represents AUC (%) on a linear scale from 75 to 100. Five distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker style, depict different performance curves: a blue line with circle markers starts at approximately 94% and peaks near 100% before declining; an orange line with diamond markers begins at about 84% and rises to nearly 96% before leveling off; a green line with star markers starts around 87%, increases to about 92%, and then stabilizes near 94%; a red line with square markers begins at roughly 88%, rises to nearly 100%, and then decreases to about 91%; and a magenta line with triangle markers remains low, starting at approximately 80%, sharply increasing to nearly 97% at N=10, then declining to about 82% by N=20.
